definitions.gloss: first-time customer; walk-in customer without an introduction
definitions.explanation: A customer visiting an establishment for the first time without a prior introduction from a regular patron. The term is strongly associated with traditional Kyoto culture, where some exclusive establishments require an introduction from a known patron.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一見|いちげん}さんお{断|ことわ}りだ。
examples.english: This establishment does not accept first-time customers.

examples.japanese: ⟦{京都|きょうと}→京都：09484_kyouto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{料亭|りょうてい}→料亭：21710_ryoutei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一見|いちげん}さんお{断|ことわ}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Some traditional restaurants in Kyoto do not accept first-time walk-in customers.

examples.japanese: ⟦{常連|じょうれん}→常連：06878_jouren⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{知|し}り{合|あ}い→知り合い：03253_shiriai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{紹介|しょうかい}して→紹介する：05641_shoukaisuru⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、{一見|いちげん}さんお{断|ことわ}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{入|はい}れ→入る：00494_hairu⟧た。
examples.english: Because a regular acquaintance introduced me, I was able to get into a place that normally turns away first-time customers.

notes:
USAGE:
The phrase {一見|いちげん}さんお⟦{断|ことわ}り→断る：02102_kotowaru⟧ (no first-time customers without introduction) is the most common usage of this word. It refers to a traditional business practice, especially in Kyoto, where exclusive restaurants, tea houses, and geisha districts require new customers to be introduced by existing patrons. This practice ensures trust and proper etiquette.

CULTURAL NOTE:
The {一見|いちげん}さんお⟦{断|ことわ}り→断る：02102_kotowaru⟧ system is most associated with Kyoto's ⟦{花街|かがい}→花街：17224_kagai⟧ (geisha districts) and high-end ⟦{料亭|りょうてい}→料亭：21710_ryoutei⟧ (traditional restaurants). It is not meant to be exclusionary but rather to maintain a relationship of trust between the establishment and its clientele.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一見|いちげん}さんお⟦{断|ことわ}り→断る：02102_kotowaru⟧ (no first-time customers)
- {一見|いちげん}さんで⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{入|はい}れる→入る：00494_hairu⟧ (open to first-timers too)
